name: 89048 · Pahrump, NV
findings: ZIP 89048 (Pahrump) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89048 (Pahrump) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89048 (Pahrump) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
